name: Maximum Classes Are Projection-Closed
statement: Every nonempty coordinate projection of a maximum class is maximum at its resulting VC dimension.
proof: For a split at one coordinate, write the two shores as $C_i^0,C_i^1$, their union as $U$, and their intersection as $I$. The VC dimensions of $U$ and $I$ are at most $d$ and $d-1$. Since $|C|=|U|+|I|$ and the corresponding Sauer bounds sum to the maximum size of $C$, equality holds in both bounds; in particular $U$ is maximum. Iterate over projected coordinates.
